<sealed-runtime>/dotnet <sealed-helper>/NativeRootCoordinator.dll --execute

## Original clock and ownership

The flag uses CLOCK_BOOTTIME (clock id 7), the fixture /proc/uptime domain. It accepts an **existing**
absolute end at most 600 seconds away. The fixture must pass an end no later than its already-owned
work boundary and remaining root unit/command budget; this helper cannot choose or extend those bounds.
[N07CoordinatorData](N07CoordinatorData.cs) derives `work_end = original_end - 5000ms`. Five seconds are
reserved **inside** that end for resume, original task/watch joins, descriptor closes and output. No
cleanup grace, renewed start deadline, wall-clock conversion or new 600-second interval is created.
Short stop polls use the same token and check the original clock before/after each wait.

The original RunAsync task and watchdog task are retained before dispatch. Work expiry cancels and
closes the owned rendezvous socket to wake I/O. Finally switches only to the already-reserved portion
of the same absolute end, attempts SIGCONT through the retained original pidfd, closes every owned
socket/FD independently, joins the original watchdog, then publishes. Any initial or cleanup failure
keeps numeric exit 1; cleanup cannot replace it with success. Watch failure also prevents success.
No signal falls back to kill(numericPID), cached metadata, a replacement process or a fresh grace.
If the original has died, changed identity or the hard end has expired, resume remains unconfirmed;
the original external utility/owner/worker watchdogs must contain it. There is no fake all-joined flag.
The helper does not own the worker's terminal task, cgroup, or paired output pumps: the fixture must
join and prove those original holders separately. Kernel/system-call stalls still require that existing
external containment; managed clock checks alone are not physical termination evidence.

## Fixed sequence and parent custody

1. Retain request, descriptor, runtime, entry, original root supervisor /proc files, executable and pidfd.
   Validate exact supervisor argv and original owner cgroup. Connect only the fixed root-created N07
   checkpoint `/run/appsurface-evidence-n07-<run-id>/checkpoint.sock`, root:root 0600, and require actual
   SO_PEERCRED equal to the selected live original owner PID/UID0/GID0.
2. Await exact `N07 READY_PREPARED <run-id>\n`. Capture the genuine postexec ordinary CLI worker with
   its own pidfd, UID4/GID4/startticks/exe/argv/cgroup bracketed before/after reads; require unchanged
   NNP1 and CapEff0. Retain the actual workspace run directory and original worker-owned 0700 output
   directory FD. Its device/inode must equal the descriptor's expected parent identity, links must be2,
   and bounded descriptor-relative getdents64 must show only `.`/`..`.
3. Before SIGSTOP, require actual helper root UID/GID/supplementary groups, NNP1 and existing effective
   CHOWN, DAC_READ_SEARCH, KILL and SYS_PTRACE bits. This check enables nothing and does not alter policy;
   missing prerequisites fail. Register the possible SIGCONT obligation before dispatch, then signal
   only the retained original pidfd and observe the same process's T/t state.
4. While that genuine worker is stopped, atomically rename only `output` to the generated sibling
   `output-n07-retained-<run-id>` with renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE). Existing sibling causes rejection,
   never replacement. Keep its original directory FD. Create a new `output` exclusively, seal worker
   UID/GID and 0700, and require a different nonzero inode on the same actual device. Before/after checks
   bind original quarantine and replacement names to retained FDs, full leaf metadata and empty contents.
   The root run directory retains its identity/owner/mode; expected child-related directory times/link
   count may change through these deliberate operations. No tool/control/subject/raw-result name is touched.
5. Send only exact `N07 RELEASE_READY <run-id>\n`; await genuine `N07 READY_COMMITTED <run-id>\n` from
   the same original root peer, recheck the stopped worker and both parent objects, then SIGCONT that
   same retained worker. Recheck original owner, request/descriptor and both parent objects once more.

Every partial mutation leaves real directories/names quarantined. No rollback deletes, adopts or
reuses unknown objects, restores a name by overwriting another one, calls workspace custody, or releases
accounts. Successful directory comparisons do not constitute artifact authority. The original account
NSS facts and original object's disposition must be retained by the later root fixture/ephemeral VM.

**Important ordering limit:** the core's unchanged post-write/listener/worker guards may reject after
parent replacement but before READY commitment or Allocate. That is inconclusive for N07, even if a
root task fails or worker status6 appears. Do not weaken these guards or infer Allocate from generic410.
The source-owned root nextAccept gate releases only after its actual original stderr pump reads the
allocation-catch frame. This helper neither reads/steals that pipe nor synthesizes the frame/event.
The coordinator can observe parent substitution and genuine notifications; actual allocation denial
must be established later from authentic root-owned capture and unchanged final source holders.

## Output and required external evidence

Inherited stdout and stderr must already be root:root regular0600, single-link, empty and bounded by
existing fixture limits. Program emits at most one root-private JSON plus LF, <=4096 bytes. It does not
print exception type/message/stack, paths, request bodies or stderr bytes. Its schema is
`issue779-n07-root-coordinator-result-v1`. A completed observation contains fixed status
`parent-substitution-observed`, generation, actual original owner/worker PID/startticks/UID4/GID4/groups/
cgroups, actual worker NNP/cap strings, successful stop/commit/resume observations, original/replacement
parent device/inode/owner/mode/link metadata, and request/descriptor SHA bindings. It always sets
`allocation_observed=false`, `native_authority=false`, `native_acceptance=false`. Failure emits only
fixed status `inconclusive`, a closed source stage and false authority/acceptance, and returns1.
Success of these limited helper operations returns0, **not** N07 credit. Post-flush check of the same
original end is mandatory; a late/missing/partial JSON and numeric failure cannot be reused as success.
The future fixture must retain actual numeric terminal state and apply its own late-failure invalidation;
there is no new archive/publication interface or fabricated sidecar in this packet.

Before N07 can be credited the future fixture must bind all of the following separately:

- Full source-built ordinary CLI image, helper/Linux FDD output and shared sealed tool/runtime maps;
  original request/policy/descriptor/canonical verification and authenticated root capture provenance.
- Actual original pump's exact nine-field `issue779-n07-precleanup-allocation-fault-v1` frame:
  phase Allocation, operation CheckParentIdentity, error_family Admission, position
  AllocateCatchBeforeCallbackRethrow; no invented terminal. The root-owned result must bind full real
  stderr/stdout bytes and their digests without public echo.
- Genuine READY commitment and original event; physical original worker terminal code/status left
  exactly as measured (including signal6), both original EOFs/full quotas/no discard, original control,
  accept/handler/task joins, owner/worker unit and physical cgroup settlement, actual NSS quarantine,
  original/replacement inode/name comparisons and no producer/writer activation.
- Complete fixed retention names/bounds/canonical digest and root-only data parser; arbitrary JSON,
  supplied expected tuples, helperexit0 or CI success cannot replace original physical holders.

## Controls, reference API and remaining prerequisites

[PossibleStopRegistrationControls.cs.in](PossibleStopRegistrationControls.cs.in) defines eight exact
ordering controls over the copied original helper: pre-dispatch registration, stop/resume failures,
reference mismatch, duplicate/reentrant dispatch and invalid arguments. They construct no native pin.
[N07CoordinatorDataControls.cs.in](N07CoordinatorDataControls.cs.in) defines eight controls for the
actual generation/identity/deadline arithmetic used by Program. The templates are excluded from the
helper's three explicit Compile items. Main may later compile them separately with their actual
source classes and a finite data entry point; no helper Main invocation is implied. Defined16, run0.

[OutputParentReplacement](Program.cs) owns native descriptors; `Open` verifies exact expected identity,
`Replace` performs the one fixed mutation, `Recheck` compares both held/named objects, and `Dispose`
attempts all original closes without deleting names. [PossibleStopRegistration](PossibleStopRegistration.cs)
is internal serial-use bookkeeping: Stop registers first, Resume clears only after the same original
complete operation returns. No detached control value becomes native authority. Clock and native
classes accept no public factory, callback transport, injected descriptor or runtime-case switch.
